incr.order: frame-major: buf[f*n + i] is element i at frame f

slip.order: frame-major: buf[f*n + i] is element i at frame f

critical_friction.meaning: largest frame (hence mu) at which the element still slips; the active set is nested so this is single valued, which mu_sweep verifies before writing it

regional_stress.note: compression positive; axes[0] is the maximum compression direction (SHmax), axes[2] the minimum
